Game Overview

In Flying Comet, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a comet through captivating cosmic challenges in Flying Comet. Master precision and reflexes to dodge dynamic obstacles, with only two crashes allowed per level. Enjoy addictive gameplay as you progress through diverse levels, balancing speed and strategy for an exhilarating experience in the cosmos.
